title: SimTok: Simulating Filter Bubble on Short-video Recommender System with Large Language Model Agents

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of user-agents' assigned phone prices (used as a proxy for income) and city-levels (representing economic development) on content diversity and filter bubble severity via Empirical Cumulative Probability Functions (ECDF) over entropy.

Comparing the recommendation content diversity (coverage and entropy metrics) across LLM user-agents assigned to different age demographic groups to see which groups are more susceptible to filter bubbles.
Measuring the differences in recommendation diversity and filter bubble formation between male and female assigned LLM user-agents during the recommendation simulation.
